mkdir -p /opt/cursor/artifacts && cat > /opt/cursor/artifacts/code-tour-author-handoff.md << 'EOF'
<decision>
Late fee is elapsed time from the issued instant: due at 30 × 24 hours, 1% of the current unpaid balance until 7 × 24 hours past due, then 2%, each rate rounded half up on its own. Set aside calendar end-of-day due dates, 2% of the original invoice amount, floor or ceiling rounding, halving an already-rounded 2% fee, and charging only the 1%→2% increase on a later night.
</decision>
<risk>
Exact due instant is still 0; the full 2% starts at exactly 7 × 24 hours past due. Sub-cent results can round to 0. Unparseable issuedAt or negative/non-integer cents throw. Timestamps with no offset are read as UTC.
</risk>
<verified>
node scratch/check.ts (boundaries, partial pay, rounding, offsets, real clock) and node smoke.ts. Both exited 0.
</verified>
EOF
